name: Update report
desc: Pending OS updates, reboots needed and the monitor's own version, per host, with a safe order to apply them. Report only.
prompt: For each selected host: pending package updates (updates.list where available), whether a reboot is pending (host.reboot_required: exit code 0 means yes), and the OS-upgrade hints in get_host. Also say whether a new HomeLab Monitor release is available (get_snapshot). Suggest a safe order (least important box first, the hub and anything serving models last). Do not apply anything.
